brief: Separate recurring, irregular and one-time receipts when estimating future income.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Not every receipt repeats"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "No toda entrada se repite"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Nem toda entrada se repete"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Separate recurring, irregular and one-time receipts when estimating future income.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Separate repeatable receipts from one-time money before planning.
instruction.misconception: Treat every recent receipt as dependable future income.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: A 50-dollar gift arrived once. Weekly pay repeats under its agreement; the gift has no such agreement.
The work condition limits when payment occurs.
The repeating agreement still has a stated condition.
An asset sale is not a repeating payment agreement.
The exceptional receipt should not silently become recurring income.
The stated one-time condition limits future estimates.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
